stories.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal eye move for Marseille's Paixão

stories.headline: Packers star RB Josh Jacobs charged with two misdemeanors
stories.summary: Packers running back Josh Jacobs has been charged with misdemeanor battery and misdemeanor criminal damage to property, according to Wisconsin court records.

stories.headline: Jets star goalie Connor Hellebuyck confirms trade request
stories.summary: Three-time Vezina Trophy-winning goaltender Connor Hellebuyck publicly confirmed Thursday that he asked the Winnipeg Jets to trade him.

stories.headline: MLB pitches free-agent frenzy period similar to NFL, NBA
stories.summary: MLB has proposed limiting free-agent signings to several weeks in December and then from early February on each offseason along with a ban on trades during the gap in between.

stories.headline: Champions League draw: Good games for Liverpool, bad for Barcelona

stories.headline: Caitlin Clark debuts Taylor Swift friendship bracelet-inspired Caitlin 1s
stories.summary: The Indiana Fever star is a longtime fan of the superstar artist, with her new Caitlin 1 sneakers paying homage to her friendship bracelet from Swift's Eras Tour.

stories.headline: Player development key for Real Salt Lake despite departure of Zavier Gozo
stories.summary: Real Salt Lake sporting director Kurt Schmid said the club won't be changing its emphasis on player development, even in the wake of securing a $15 million transfer fee from Crystal Palace for winger Zavier Gozo.

stories.headline: Red Bull still won't be granted engine upgrade opportunities, rivals Mercedes and Ferrari will
stories.summary: Red Bull Powertrains will continue into the second half of the season as the only Formula 1 engine manufacturer that has not been granted an upgrade opportunity for its power unit.

stories.headline: Cris Cyborg is still going strong as a force in women's P4P top 10
stories.summary: At age 41, PFL women's featherweight champion continues win streak to secure spot in ESPN P4P top 10.

stories.headline: Miserable Broncos humbled by Storm at Suncorp
stories.summary: The heat on Michael Maguire has reached boiling point after Brisbane were humbled 46-20 by Melbourne at Suncorp Stadium.

stories.headline: Chelsea set to sign Emiliano Martínez from Aston Villa - sources
stories.summary: Chelsea have agreed to a deal to sign Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez from Aston Villa for a fee of £7.5 million (10.2m), sources confirmed to ESPN's James Olley.
